articles.summary: India imports approximately 87% of its crude oil. With the Middle East in prolonged conflict and crude above $100 per barrel, this dependence has moved from a background cost to an active pressure point. We discussed the pressures on India's current account in a previous issue. Policy responses to reduce this dependence have already been going on.
